content: संतप् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To heat, warm; संतप्तचामीकर <ls>Bk. 3. 3</ls>; संतप्तायसि संस्थितस्य पयसो नामापि न ज्ञायते <ls>Bh. 2. 67</ls>. .²2 To parch, dry up. .²3 To pain by heat, torture. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} .²1 To become hot or heated. .²2 To be distressed, suffer pain, be sorry; संतप्तानां त्वमसि शरणम् <ls>Me. 7</ls> ‘of the afflicted’; दिवापि मयि निष्क्रान्ते संतप्येते गुरू मम <ls>Mb.</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 87</ls>. .²3 To repent, be stung with remorse; अवधूतप्रणिपाताः पश्चात् संतप्यमानमनसोऽपि <ls>V. 3. 5</ls>. .²4 To undergo penance. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To heat, burn, inflame. .²2 To provoke, exasperate, irritate. .²3 To torment, torture, distress, afflict. .²4 To burn up, consume. .²5 To foment (quarrels <ab>&c.</ab>).
